highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.0.0 preview modernizes the binding and platform surface for the next major release.
highlights_body: The preview brings current Skia and HarfBuzz foundations, .NET 9 support, and broad view-layer compatibility work.

breaking.title: Obsolete APIs removed
breaking.body: APIs that were previously marked obsolete have been removed for the major-version transition. Rebuild your application and replace each obsolete member with its documented modern alternative.

bullets.detail: Updates the target-platform integration for current .NET releases and the newer WinForms GL control packages.
Refreshes the native graphics and text-shaping components for the v3 preview line.
